description: A purple shirt lies on a light green bedspread in front of a brown headboard and a white wall. The right hand reaches in to grab and pull the fabric open while the left hand steadies it, then both hands smooth it flat; the left hand folds one side inward and the right hand folds the other side over it to form a long rectangle, and finally the hands fold the rectangle up into a compact bundle and slide it away, releasing it.
